purpose: Measure validated mathematical progress at equal normalized token checkpoints and minimum observed cost to reach equivalent stages.
canonical_problem: Characterize ALLOW admissibility for an abstract GCAT/BCAT evaluator. Let GBP, BD, and OC be predicates on a candidate transition. The evaluator returns ALLOW exactly when GBP and BD and OC all hold. Establish the necessary-and-sufficient characterization, state the claim boundary, and prepare a Lean 4 candidate for the logical core. Do not invent a deployed-engine specification or claim implementation validity.
admission_rule: A stage is admitted only when all stage-specific semantic anchors are present case-insensitively, task identity remains fixed, and the lane does not assert deployed-engine validity. These anchors intentionally accept equivalent wording rather than requiring one exact sentence.
accounting_rule: All serialized task, stage instructions, retained prior artifacts, governance instructions, outputs, and validator records are counted with cl100k_base. Native provider usage and observed API cost remain separate receipts.
claim_boundary: This experiment measures progress through a stipulated formalization. It does not establish correctness for a deployed GCAT/BCAT implementation.
